family.label: Walton family (Walton Enterprises, LLC, including shares of the Walton Family Holdings Trust it votes)

structure.note: One class of common stock. Walton Enterprises, LLC, managed by four WELLCO Mgmt Trusts whose trustees are Walton family members, holds 3,002,673,393 shares and votes another 513,524,456 shares owned by the Walton Family Holdings Trust under an irrevocable proxy, for 44.11% in total. The proxy calls this 'approximately 44%' held by entities related to Sam Walton's family. That is below 50%, so the company is not majority-controlled on these figures.

geography.basis: Total revenues aggregated by the Company's U.S. and non-U.S. operations

notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 (Walmart calls it fiscal 2026; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2026'). Filings are the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0000104169-26-000055, filed March 13, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement (accession 0001193125-26-173673, filed April 23, 2026), as of April 10, 2026 with 7,970,990,515 Shares outstanding. Cash and stock-comp values are cross-checked against SEC XBRL. FAMILY HOLDING: the proxy lists Walton Enterprises, LLC at 44.11% and the Walton Family Holdings Trust at 6.44%, but the 44.11% already includes the trust's 513,524,456 shares (footnote 3: Walton Enterprises has sole voting power over them by irrevocable proxy). The trust is therefore not listed as a separate holder; adding it would double-count. Individual Walton family members' own holdings (e.g. directors Greg Penner and Steuart Walton in the officers-and-directors table) are not added, because the proxy does not give an aggregate for them and they may overlap with the family entities. HOLDERS: the 2026 proxy's 5% table lists only the two Walton entities; Vanguard, listed at 5.16% in 2025, is no longer in it, so largestHolders is empty. DIVIDENDS exclude $439 million paid to noncontrolling interest. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow statement has no separate share-based compensation line; the figure is the note total ($3,603 million), including plans of consolidated subsidiaries granted in their own stock. LISTING: since December 9, 2025 the stock trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (previously NYSE), still as WMT.

taxes.notes: Taxes: the supplemental cash-flow line 'Income taxes paid', tagged us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet for FY2026; the caption does not say whether refunds are netted. R&D not reported as a separate line in the FY2026 10-K (retailer).

stores.label: Retail units
stores.definition: Total retail units in the state (Walmart supercenters, discount stores, Neighborhood Markets and Sam's Clubs), per the location-facts footnote "Total retail units as of January 19, 2026."

employees.label: Associates
employees.definition: "Number of associates in the state, as of July 25, 2025."

averageWage.label: Average hourly wage, full-time hourly field associates
averageWage.definition: Average wage "For full-time hourly field associates, as of July 25, 2025." Value is US dollars per hour, not millions.

supplierSpend.label: Spent with suppliers
supplierSpend.definition: Spend with suppliers in the state; footnote: "Supplier figures provided by Dun & Bradstreet for FYE 2025." Published rounded (e.g. "$1.9 B"); converted to millions.

taxesCollected.label: Taxes collected from customers and paid
taxesCollected.definition: "Collected on behalf of state and local tax jurisdictions as part of transactional sales of taxable goods and services for FYE 2026." Published rounded; converted to millions.

taxesPaid.label: Taxes paid directly by Walmart
taxesPaid.definition: "State and Local Taxes (including but not limited to: Income Tax, Property Tax, and Sales Tax) paid directly by Walmart to state and local tax jurisdictions in addition to the taxes collected and paid on behalf of customers for FYE 2026."

footprint.notes: U.S. state rows (50 states + DC) come from Walmart's corporate location-facts pages (corporate.walmart.com/about/location-facts/united-states/<state>). The pages render their numbers from a single company-hosted data file, locations.js, which is the document cited and quoted; the state pages themselves ship empty placeholders. No newer edition found (checked 2026-11-24): the re-fetched locations.js carries the same figures for every state, and the state-page footnotes still date them retail units as of Jan 19, 2026; associates and average wage as of Jul 25, 2025; taxes for FYE 2026 (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026); supplier spend FYE 2025 (Dun & Bradstreet). Money values are published rounded ('$1.9 B', '$170.8 M', or exact dollars such as '$183,718' for Delaware and '$340,126' for Montana taxes collected) and are stored in USD millions; quotes carry a bracketed conversion where it changes the number. 'N/A' entries were omitted, not zeroed. totalRetailUnits is used as published, not summed from formats (Alabama's formats sum to 143 vs 144 published). averageWage uses a nonstandard unit (USD per hour) because no listed unit fits. The data file has copy errors in prose (Alaska's description mentions Texas) but stateID/state fields match every key and no two states share an identical stats block. Puerto Rico is also in the file (not a state; omitted from usStates and countries). Country rows are Walmart International unit counts from the newest quarterly 'Unit Counts and Square Footage' PDF on stock.walmart.com (Q3 fiscal 2027, as of Oct 31, 2026; the 18 country totals sum to the 5,808 international total); this is newer than the fiscal year of the FY2026 10-K (year ended Jan 31, 2026), whose Item 2 still gives only segment totals (Walmart U.S. 4,611, Sam's Club U.S. 601, International 5,743) and no by-country table. U.S. total units (5,211 at Oct 31, 2026) are not repeated as a country row. Walmart's country location-facts pages give current unit totals only, no associates.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate head count at the January 31, 2026 fiscal year end from the FY2026 10-K (about 1.6 million in the U.S. and 0.5 million internationally; in the U.S. about 92% are hourly and 68% full-time). Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total wage or staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used. The considered population was about 2.1 million full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary associates at December 31, 2025, excluding about 100,000 associates in 26 countries; annualized gross earnings were used to find the median.
